workspace-git.observation_only: On-disk Git changes; unsaved editor text is not included. This observation is not test, acceptance or merge evidence.
workspace-git.select_change_help: Choose a file to compare the working tree or staged changes. Your editing draft remains in Files.
workspace-git.unavailable_not_repository: This workspace is not a Git repository
workspace-git.unavailable_git_unavailabl: Git is unavailable on the server
workspace-git.unavailable_unsupported_la: This Git workspace layout is not supported
workspace-git.unavailable_help: File editing remains available. Ask your administrator to check the bound workspace and server Git configuration.
workspace-git.clean_help: No changed files were reported in this observation. Unsaved editor text is not part of the on-disk Git state.
workspace-git.head: HEAD
workspace-git.truncated: Only the first {{limit}} files are loaded. Use the repository tools for the remaining files.
workspace-git.restricted: {{count}} restricted files excluded; their paths are not exposed.
workspace-git.changed_title: The workspace changed since it was read
workspace-git.changed_help: The binding, HEAD or index may have changed. Refresh changes to inspect a new observation; the editor draft is retained.
workspace-git.conflict_help: A two-way preview cannot represent this conflict safely. Inspect the file in the editor and resolve it with your repository tools.
workspace-git.binary_help: Git identified binary content. Raw bytes are not loaded into the text preview.
workspace-git.invalid_status: The Git observation does not match this project or the supported response contract. Refresh changes to read it again.
workspace-git.invalid_diff: The comparison does not match the selected project, file, source, HEAD or exact text digests. No unverified code is displayed.
workspace-git.local_workspace_disabled_h: Ask the deployment administrator to configure an allowed workspace directory before binding this project.
